integrity: All enumerative checks reproducible using checker.py; finite evidence only corroborates exact identities. The joint Poisson and logical limits rest on the proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Even sizes only; one fixed directed cyclic successor and an independent uniform perfect matching; fixed first-order sentences. Uses bounded-degree Hanf locality. Historical priority uncertain, particularly under stronger general coloured-configuration-model theorems. No claim for fully ordered chord diagrams or uniform growing-rank logical complexity.
title: Effective first-order limits for cyclic successor with a random perfect matching
